title: ATC-20 Rapid Evaluation Results — Teams A, B, C and Spruce Hill Overlook, 13:04–13:12

fields.organization: Marlow County Building Department — Post-Earthquake Safety Evaluation (EOC Building Desk, Kellerton)
fields.location: Kellerton EOC (911 backup positions); Kellerton Fire Station 3; Marlow Coast High School; Marlow Coast Community Hospital (exterior, from Hemlock above the XXL line); Front Street (from Spruce Hill overlook)
fields.inspector: L. Ferreira, PE (Team B lead); J. Halvorsen, PE (Team C lead); R. Okafor, PE (Team A lead), Structural Engineers Association volunteers; T. Nguyen, Building Inspector
fields.unit: SEA Rapid Evaluation Teams A, B, C · County Building Inspector T. Nguyen
fields.weather: Cold rain, 49°F, west wind; harbor still surging
fields.summary: Results radioed in and walked to the Building Department desk between 13:04 and 13:12. Three placards posted: 911 backup positions at the Kellerton EOC INSPECTED (green), Kellerton Fire Station 3 RESTRICTED USE (yellow), Marlow Coast High School INSPECTED (green). Marlow Coast Community Hospital was observed from outside only, with binoculars from Hemlock above the XXL line. No placard is posted there. Team A did not go down because the Tsunami Warning is still in effect and the harbor is still surging. Front Street masonry has not been inspected. From the Spruce Hill overlook, at least five brick facades are down. All teams are back above the line and need their next assignment: (1) the Kellerton chimney collapse and the Fire District stations above the line, or (2) staging at the XXL line so the hospital and Front Street can be inspected as soon as the zone opens. The hospital CMO is still asking for someone to clear the west wing so staff can get oxygen out.

findings.notes: INSPECTED (green). Placard dated 13 Apr 2027 13:06, signed L. Ferreira, PE. Ceiling tiles down in the radio room. No structural damage seen.
RESTRICTED USE (yellow). Placard dated 13 Apr 2027 13:08, signed L. Ferreira, PE. Canopy cracked at the column base. Nobody is under the canopy. No entry under the canopy.
Bays OK. Use them as the yellow placard allows.
INSPECTED (green). Placard dated 13 Apr 2027 13:10, signed J. Halvorsen, PE. Gym and library OK. Light fixtures down in the band room.

findings.item: Marlow Coast Community Hospital: east wing
findings.notes: Exterior observation only, with binoculars from Hemlock. NO PLACARD POSTED. Diagonal cracking visible on the 2nd floor. Debris and standing water around the ground floor.

findings.item: Marlow Coast Community Hospital: west wing (oxygen request)
findings.notes: Not seen from the Hemlock position. No entry made. Inside the inundation zone.

Seen from the Spruce Hill overlook by T. Nguyen. The two-story brick facade at the Front Street siren pole is down in the street, and at least four other facades are gone. All of these buildings are below the line.
Reported to 911 after the 11:52 aftershock. Above the line. No team assigned yet.

findings.item: Fire District stations above the line

actionsTaken: Posted the INSPECTED placard at the 911 backup positions, 13:06, with the date and inspector name written on it
Posted the RESTRICTED USE placard at Kellerton Fire Station 3, 13:08. Told the crew to keep everyone out from under the apron canopy
Posted the INSPECTED placard at Marlow Coast High School, 13:10. Told the shelter team lead to keep the band room closed
Team A pulled back from Hemlock without entering the hospital site. No placard posted
T. Nguyen observed Front Street from the Spruce Hill overlook only. No one entered the zone
Radioed all results to the Building Department desk and walked this form to the EOC at 13:12
recommendations: Building Official: assign the next task for Teams A, B and C. Option 1: the Kellerton chimney collapse and the Fire District stations above the line. Option 2: stage at the XXL line for the hospital and Front Street
Hospital and Front Street need a full rapid evaluation once Command opens the zone. Allow time for the hospital east wing and for about 40 URM buildings
Answer the CMO's west-wing oxygen request. No team has looked at the west wing
Re-check all three placards after any M 6 or larger aftershock
fields.photosNote: 9 photos attached: TB-0412 to TB-0415 (radio room ceiling, Station 3 canopy column base, bays); TC-0101 to TC-0102 (high school gym, band room fixtures); TA-0031 to TA-0032 (hospital east wing from Hemlock, telephoto); TN-0007 (Front Street facades from the Spruce Hill overlook)
fields.signature: L. Ferreira, PE, Team B Lead, Structural Engineers Association volunteer

instructorNote: This tests whether the Building Official uses the SOP-EQ-02 §4 priority list for sites above the line. Look for these actions: send teams to the Kellerton chimney and the upland stations, stage the other teams for the hospital and Front Street, keep inspectors out of the zone until Command gives a return order, and log the hospital as unplacarded (exterior observation only). Also check that the 911 Supervisor posts the green placard with its date and inspector, and that Command gets oxygen to the CMO from upland sources instead of sending anyone back into the hospital.
